snippet.title: RPG Alphadia F - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Awaken the power of energi in a classic fantasy RPG adventure!

Alphadia F

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/search?q=%22RPG%20Alphadia%20F%22%20AND%20KEMCO&c=apps
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756705589

Embark on an epic fantasy JRPG adventure in the world of Valhalard, a planet created by the Divine Creator, Nal Tauzent and divided among four great nations. When six mysterious crystals suddenly fall from the sky in the year 6350 of the New Ceressia Era, peace collapses and chaos spreads across the land. Leifer, a captain in the 7th Knight Division of the Alexand Kingdom, and his childhood friend, the mage Torte, are tasked with investigating the crystals and the strange events surrounding their hometown. Joined by memorable allies from across the world, they set out on a journey that will uncover divine secrets and decide the fate of Valhalard in this classic turn-based fantasy RPG.

Experience strategic turn-based battles powered by the signature energi system of the Alphadia series. Build up the Break Gauge to unleash devastating Break Skills, and awaken hidden power through Energi Drive to gain massive stat boosts and unlock exclusive abilities. Gather ingredients during your travels and create powerful meals through both creative cooking and recipe-based systems. Featuring a large cast of heroes, vibrant fantasy settings, character progression, and fast-paced command battles, this remake of Alphadia IV delivers a nostalgic yet refined JRPG experience for fans of retro role-playing games and anime-inspired adventures.
